decisions.reason: The skin and hair supplement is close to the core pharmacy offer and costs little to carry, but its absence from the website since launch and the earlier withdrawal of sibling supplements A and D suggest it is falling short of aspirations, so dropping it is a real possibility.

As an extension of the established Trivital brand, the joint supplement uses existing channels at low incremental cost, and an expanding firm has the slack to keep it despite little visible promotion.

The valsartan generic survived the 2018 recall and fits the firm's broad generics range, which it is committed to, so despite weak results it remains part of the portfolio rather than triggering a withdrawal.

The OTC triptan fits the stated strategy of broadening consumer health products in a differentiated self-medication niche, and the expanding firm has slack to give this recent launch time to prove itself.
